title: CLAUDE
html:
CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

What this is

This is an Obsidian knowledge vault run as an AI second brain — there is no build, test, or run step. It is a Korean-language research system for a project that reimagines the theatre as an actor-network (🧠 행위자-네트워크 이론(Actor-Network Theory)): light, sound, objects, and space are not background but actors on equal footing with the human performer. Moving away from the vision-centric, narrative-centric, human-centric stage, it explores a theatre where many non-human actors and many senses coexist — re-thinking the hierarchy (🧠 위계) among the senses, especially the role of the auditory (🧠 청각), as an aesthetic strategy.

Write notes in Korean. Match the tone and structure of existing notes in 02_WIKI/.

Architecture — a three-layer LLM wiki

Modeled on Karpathy's LLM-wiki idea (https://gist.github.com/karpathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f): knowledge is synthesized once and compounds, instead of being re-derived from raw material each time.

  1. RAW (00_RAW/) — source layer, immutable & single source of truth. Interviews, discussions, documents, PDFs. Treat as read-only (see per-subfolder exceptions). Every claim in the wiki should trace back here.
  2. WIKI (02_WIKI/) — synthesized layer. ~178 atomic, densely cross-linked notes that Claude owns: it creates, links, reinforces, and de-duplicates them. The only place wiki notes are authored.
  3. SCHEMA — this file + 03_TEMPLATE/. Conventions and workflows.

The 🧩 hub notes + Dataview act as the dynamic index (no static index.md to hand-maintain). The top-level entry point is 🧩 인덱스(MOC) — a Map of Content that links the main hubs and auto-lists every 🧩 hub. The append-only ingestion ledger is 00_RAW/_LOG.md. Contradictions between sources are not silently overwritten — they are flagged and connected with the 긴장 relation.

Publication

The vault is published to the web (Obsidian Publish / share-note), so every note must stay publication-clean:

  • No internal bookkeeping inside notes. References to 00_RAW/_LOG.md or the ingestion process live only in the log itself — never quoted in a note.
  • DISCUSSION / interview notes omit 메모 및 비평. Do not append editorial commentary inside someone else's interview; keep them to the verbatim transcript plus 요약 · 핵심 개념 · 인용.

Folder layout

  • 00_RAW/ — immutable source layer. Do not rewrite, reword, summarize, or reorder content here.
    • 00_RAW/DISCUSSION/ — interviews & discussions with collaborators (e.g. 📚 인터뷰 *). These get connected into the wiki (see workflow); their wording is never otherwise changed.
    • 00_RAW/DOCUMENTS/ — web articles, PDFs, external texts. Never edited and never back-linked into. Mined into the wiki; provenance flows wiki → document, not the reverse.
  • 00_FILES/ — binary attachments embedded in notes via ![[ ]] (images, score PDFs). Not source material to mine. (Cosmetic note: shares the 00_ prefix with 00_RAW; a PDF that is a source-to-read belongs in 00_RAW/DOCUMENTS, not here.)
  • 01_WORKING/ — scratch / in progress (usually empty).
  • 02_WIKI/ — the synthesized notes. Create and edit wiki notes only here.
  • 03_TEMPLATE/ — the six note templates (read before creating a new note).
  • .obsidian/ — Obsidian app + plugin config. Do not edit unless explicitly asked.
  • .smart-env/, .smtcmp_* — vector DB / embeddings cache (Smart Composer, Smart Connections). Generated; never hand-edit.

Ingestion workflow (RAW → WIKI)

Ingestion is conversational and user-initiated (Karpathy's model — there is no auto-trigger and no one-shot command). The user drops a source and starts the conversation; you read it, discuss the key takeaways together as you integrate, and the user curates/directs while you handle the mechanical bookkeeping (links, summaries, log). Process one source at a time.

00_RAW/DISCUSSION/ (collaborator interviews & talks):

  1. Read the source. Do not change its wording, order, or spelling.
  2. Identify the 개념·인물·사례·키워드 it mentions.
  3. For each: if a 02_WIKI/ note exists, reinforce it (add the discussion's insight, add relations); if a significant one is missing, create it from the matching template.
  4. Connect with inline [[ ]] links in the body. Wrap each mentioned 개념·인물·사례 where it appears, linking the first occurrence (and meaningful recurrences). To keep the transcript reading exactly as spoken, use display aliases so the visible text is unchanged — [[🧠 공명|공명]], [[👤 미셸 시옹(Michel Chion)|시옹]]. The only edit allowed is wrapping an existing term in a link (with an alias preserving its surface form): do not reword, reorder, summarize, or fix typos. For a mention with no single term to wrap (a paraphrase), leave the text and instead list that link in a > [!INFO] 언급된 위키 노트 callout at the top of the file.
  5. The thinking in the discussion is what gets "wiki-ified": extract its claims into atomic wiki notes that cite the discussion as their source.

00_RAW/DOCUMENTS/ (web docs, PDFs):

  1. Read it. Do not edit the document and do not add backlinks into it.
  2. Extract 개념·인물·사례. Reinforce the existing 02_WIKI/ note if there is one; otherwise create it, fitting the existing schema and context.
  3. Record provenance on the wiki side: a 📚 출처 note is the synthesized citation of the raw artifact — it summarizes and points at the 00_RAW/DOCUMENTS/ file, and concept notes link to that 출처 note. Do not paste large raw text into the wiki; summarize and cite. This keeps single-source-of-truth without touching the document.

Note types and filename prefixes

Every wiki note belongs to one of six 범주 (categories), each with a template in 03_TEMPLATE/ and an emoji filename prefix. The prefix is part of the filename and of every [[wikilink]] — always include it. (RAW files are exempt from this system; they are verbatim sources, not categorized wiki notes.)

범주 Template Prefix(es) in 02_WIKI/
개념 (concept) 개념 TEMPLATE.md 🧠
인물 (person) 인물 TEMPLATE.md 👤
사례 (case/work) 사례 TEMPLATE.md 🎬 film, 📚 book, 🖼️ artwork, 🎭 theatre, 🩰 dance, 🏛 building
질문 (question) 질문 TEMPLATE.md ❓
출처 (source) 출처 TEMPLATE.md 📚
허브 (hub) 허브 TEMPLATE.md 🧩

🧩 notes are taxonomy/hub nodes (e.g. 🧩 음악, 🧩 개념, 🧩 작곡가-사운드 아티스트). They are both category labels (referenced from the 영역/분야, 역할/직업 fields) and dashboards that auto-collect related notes via Dataview. Pick the file prefix from the note's actual medium/subject, not just its 범주.

Anatomy of a note (critical conventions)

Copy the matching template and fill it in. Every wiki note has three machine-readable layers plus prose:

  1. YAML frontmatter — the single source of truth for all classification and relations. Keys are Korean, reusing the names the existing notes already use (영역/분야, 관련_개념, 감각_포커스, 창작자…) so new notes inherit and merge with existing data in Dataview. Edit these via Obsidian's Properties UI, not by hand in the body.

    • Classification: 범주 (category) · 영역/분야 (domain, → 🧩 hub) · 창작자 (제안자/창작자) · 감각_포커스 · 매체 (사례/출처) · 역할/직업 (인물) · 상태 (default 진행중) · index · tags.
    • Relations: see the predicate set below.

  2. > [!INFO] 분류 callout — a read-only display that renders the frontmatter via inline Dataview (`= this["영역/분야"]`). Do not retype values here; change them in frontmatter and this updates automatically. (Requires the Dataview plugin, which is installed.)

  3. > [!LINK]- 온톨로지 연결 (Relations) callout — renders the relation properties. The relation vocabulary is deliberately small — do not invent new ones. All are directional; you only fill the outgoing side (inverses surface via the note's normal backlinks).

    Property 뜻 Direction Used on
    상위 broader (포함·계층) → up the taxonomy 개념, 질문
    관련_개념 / 관련_사례 related (느슨한 연결) undirected all — reused from existing notes, already populated
    긴장 tension (대립·비판) → / undirected all — the project's key relation (위계 vs 평평함, 시각 vs 청각, 비필수성 논쟁), and how source/idea contradictions are flagged
    근거 grounds (지지) → toward what it supports 개념, 사례, 출처
    적용 instantiates (예시) 사례 → 이론/개념 사례
    영향 influenced_by (계보) ← 인물
    협업 collaborated_with undirected 인물

    This replaced an 11-predicate inline scheme (derives_from/challenges/expands/triggers/supports/contributes_to/applies_theory/mentored/critiqued…) that was near-unused because the distinctions were too fine. Map old → new: derives_from/expands→상위; challenges/critiqued→긴장; supports→근거; applies_theory→적용; triggers/contributes_to→관련_개념/관련_사례; mentored→영향.

    Dataview + Korean/slash keys: access keys with brackets — inline `= this["영역/분야"]`, and in queries row["영역/분야"]. Bare 영역/분야 in a query parses / as division, so always bracket. See the hub templates for working examples.

  4. Prose sections under #/--- headers, ending with a single bottom tag matching the category (#개념, #인물, #사례, #질문, #출처, #허브). These tags drive the hub Dataview queries, so every wiki note must keep its bottom tag.

Block IDs and transclusion

The key paragraph of each note carries a stable block ID so other notes can transclude it: ^definition (개념), ^description (사례), ^bio/^quotes (인물), ^question (질문), ^summary (출처). Source notes (출처) pull concept definitions in with ![[🧠 개념이름#^definition]]. When you write or move the canonical paragraph, preserve its block ID.

Linking rules

  • Connect liberally with [[wikilinks]]; the vault's value is in the graph. A link to a not-yet-created note is fine.
  • Always link with the full emoji-prefixed filename ([[🧠 공명]], not [[공명]]).
  • Prose links carry the nuance; the frontmatter relations are for the queryable graph — when a connection fits one of the predicates, also add it to that frontmatter property so hubs pick it up. Fill only the outgoing direction; the inverse surfaces via backlinks.

Dataview

  • Hub (🧩) notes hold ```dataview TABLE queries that collect notes by category tag and 영역/분야. Always scope queries to the wiki folder — FROM #개념 AND "02_WIKI" — so RAW interviews (which still carry old #출처/#사례 tags) don't leak into the dashboards.
  • Field access always uses bracket notation (this["영역/분야"], row["상위"]) — never bare, because of the / and Korean characters.
  • If you rename a frontmatter key or a bottom #category tag, you break these queries — keep them exactly as the templates define them.

Migration status

The templates in 03_TEMPLATE/ and this doc describe the current scheme. Existing 02_WIKI/ notes keep the same Korean frontmatter keys (so their 영역/분야, 관련_개념, 감각_포커스, 창작자 data merges into the queries automatically) but many still carry the old presentation: manually-typed (field:: ) inline callouts and a mostly-empty 11-predicate Relations block. Migration is progressive — not bulk. When you substantially edit an old note, convert its callouts to the new = this["…"] display and add the new relations (상위/긴장/근거/적용); otherwise leave it.

Maintenance (optional)

After each ingestion, append one row to 00_RAW/_LOG.md (date · source · type · notes created/reinforced · contradictions). When asked to lint the wiki: look for orphan notes (no in/out links), stale or duplicated concepts, missing cross-references, and source contradictions to flag with 긴장. New 🧩 hubs surface in 🧩 인덱스(MOC) automatically; add genuinely important ones to its curated sections too.
